items.sentence: Beginning [MASK] and continuing, Complainant was subjected to harassment as evidenced by the following: a.
On [MASK], the Branch Chief refused to rescind a Memorandum of Counseling regarding Treasury Enforcement Communication System (TECS) that Complainant received; b.
From [MASK] to June 2019, the Branch Chief was aware that the Supervisory CBP Officer (SCBPO-1) bullied and harassed Complainant yet took no corrective actions; c.
On [MASK], SCBPO-1 verbally reprimanded Complainant for missing a morning training class; d.
In [MASK], SCBPO-1 showed a knife to Complainant and another CBPO (CBPO-2) and informed them that he brings his knife collection to work in his backpack; e.
